items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: I had Jimmy Rowles on piano, Barney Kessel, Iggy Shevack, trumpet player

ctx.x: And I got some good bands, she'd work at Billy Berg's and we'd go to San Francisco and we made trips to St. -- up and down the coast. So the first date was Billy Bergs and I had Jimmy Rowles on piano, Barney Kessel, Iggy Shevack, trumpet player -- Neal Hefti --
